edges: Silas frightens Maud but is kind to her
Dudley attempts to court Maud but she rejects him
Maud is imprisoned under the guard of Madame de la Rougierre
Maud awakes at Bartram-Haugh after a journey
Millicent is sent to a boarding school in France with the promise that Maud will join her after three months.
Maud is married to Lord Ilbury.
